customers_type_shape.name: customers_type_shape
customers_type_shape.value:
("customers"."type" = 'Company' AND "customers"."company_name" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."pin" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."first_name" IS NULL AND "customers"."last_name" IS NULL)
       OR ("customers"."type" <> 'Company' AND "customers"."first_name" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."last_name" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."company_name" IS NULL AND "customers"."pin" IS NULL)

customers_text_lengths.name: customers_text_lengths
customers_text_lengths.value: char_length("customers"."location") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length("customers"."first_name") <= 60 AND char_length("customers"."last_name") <= 60 AND char_length("customers"."company_name") <= 120 AND char_length("customers"."pin") <= 20

suppliers_type_shape.name: suppliers_type_shape
suppliers_type_shape.value:
("suppliers"."type" = 'Company' AND "suppliers"."contact_person" IS NOT NULL AND "suppliers"."department" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("suppliers"."type" = 'Individual' AND "suppliers"."contact_person" IS NULL AND "suppliers"."kra_pin" IS NULL AND "suppliers"."department" IS NULL)

suppliers_text_lengths.name: suppliers_text_lengths
suppliers_text_lengths.value: char_length("suppliers"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length("suppliers"."location") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length("suppliers"."contact_person") <= 60 AND char_length("suppliers"."department") <= 60

technicians_text_lengths.name: technicians_text_lengths
technicians_text_lengths.value: char_length("technicians"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length("technicians"."location") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

airtime_batches_amount.name: airtime_batches_amount
airtime_batches_amount.value: ("airtime_batches"."amount_minor" IS NULL OR "airtime_batches"."amount_minor" BETWEEN 500 AND 1000000) AND "airtime_batches"."recipients" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

airtime_plans_expiry.name: airtime_plans_expiry
airtime_plans_expiry.value: ("airtime_plans"."expiry_source" = 'IMEI' AND "airtime_plans"."custom_expiry" IS NULL) OR ("airtime_plans"."expiry_source" = 'Custom' AND "airtime_plans"."custom_expiry" IS NOT NULL)

package_sales_tracker_all_or_none.name: package_sales_tracker_all_or_none

purchase_items_one_target.name: purchase_items_one_target

   OR ("purchase_items"."item_type" = 'SIM Card' AND "purchase_items"."product_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_items"."sim_card_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_items"."platform_id" IS NULL)
   OR ("purchase_items"."item_type" = 'Platform' AND "purchase_items"."product_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_items"."sim_card_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_items"."platform_id" IS NOT NULL)

retailer_card_lines_values.name: retailer_card_lines_values

retailer_product_lines_values.name: retailer_product_lines_values

sale_service_changes_service.name: sale_service_changes_service

sales_amounts.name: sales_amounts
sales_amounts.value:
("sales"."old_sale" AND "sales"."total_minor" = 0 AND "sales"."paid_minor" = 0 AND "sales"."profit_minor" = 0)
       OR (NOT "sales"."old_sale" AND "sales"."total_minor" > 0 AND "sales"."paid_minor" >= 0 AND "sales"."paid_minor" <= "sales"."total_minor")
